# YUMPU
> YUMPU is a digital publishing platform that turns PDFs into online magazines, catalogs, and flipbooks for global distribution.

YUMPU helps publishers, businesses, and organizations publish documents on the web, optimize them for search engines, and distribute them across devices and channels. The platform also supports branded readers, apps, kiosks, and analytics-oriented publishing workflows.

## Core Platform
- [YUMPU homepage](https://www.yumpu.com/en): Main entry point for digital publishing, flipbooks, and online magazine creation.
- [Publish for free](https://www.yumpu.com/en/publish): Upload PDFs and publish them as online documents and magazines.
- [Pricing](https://www.yumpu.com/en/pricing): Compare plans and features for digital publishing and distribution.
- [Login](https://www.yumpu.com/en/account/login): Sign in to manage publications, account settings, and publishing tools.
- [Register](https://www.yumpu.com/en/account/register): Create a YUMPU account to start publishing online.
- [Search publications](https://www.yumpu.com/en/search): Discover magazines, catalogs, and documents published on YUMPU.

## Product Features
- [Digital magazine publishing](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/digital-magazine): Overview of publishing magazines online with YUMPU.
- [Catalog publishing](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/catalog): Create and distribute digital catalogs from PDF files.
- [Flipbook software](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/flipbook): Convert PDFs into page-flipping online publications.
- [PDF to HTML5](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/pdf-to-html5): Publish PDF content in a mobile-friendly HTML5 reader.
- [SEO optimization](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/seo): Improve discoverability of published documents in search engines.
- [Responsive reader](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/mobile): Read and share publications across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

## Publishing Solutions
- [For publishers](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/publishers): Publishing workflows and distribution tools for magazine and media publishers.
- [For companies](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/companies): Use YUMPU for brochures, reports, catalogs, and branded documents.
- [For associations](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/associations): Publish newsletters, reports, and member communications online.
- [For agencies](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/agencies): Manage digital publications for clients and campaigns.
- [For schools](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/schools): Share yearbooks, newsletters, and educational documents digitally.
- [For public institutions](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/public-institutions): Publish official documents and informational materials online.

## Apps and Distribution
- [Apps overview](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/apps): Extend publications into mobile app and kiosk experiences.
- [iOS app publishing](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/ios-app): Publish digital magazines in a branded iOS app.
- [Android app publishing](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/android-app): Deliver publications through a branded Android application.
- [Kiosk solution](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/kiosk): Present digital publications in kiosk and display environments.
- [QR codes](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/qr-codes): Connect print materials to digital publications with QR codes.
- [Social sharing](https://www.yumpu.com/en/info/social-media): Distribute publications through social and online channels.

## Reader and Content Discovery
- [Latest publications](https://www.yumpu.com/en/browse/latest): Browse recently published magazines, catalogs, and documents.
- [Popular publications](https://www.yumpu.com/en/browse/popular): Explore widely viewed and shared publications on YUMPU.
- [Magazines](https://www.yumpu.com/en/browse/magazines): Discover digital magazines across topics and publishers.
- [Catalogs](https://www.yumpu.com/en/browse/catalogs): Find online catalogs published through the platform.
- [Documents](https://www.yumpu.com/en/browse/documents): Access brochures, reports, manuals, and other documents.
- [Publishers directory](https://www.yumpu.com/en/publishers): Browse publishers and organizations using YUMPU.
